data.summary:
Proficient in designing and deploying end-to-end AI systems for regulated industries, including healthcare and pharmaceutical documentation.
Experienced in LangChain, LangGraph, hierarchical RAG pipelines, multi-agent AI systems, and Few-Shot Learning for context-rich document generation.
Successfully reduced regulatory document authoring timelines from weeks to days, enhancing productivity and compliance for multi-region submissions.
Skilled in NER model development with >90% accuracy, improving automated data extraction and information retrieval processes.
Hands-on expertise in cloud deployment and DevOps, leveraging AWS (S3, ECS, SageMaker, OpenSearch) and Azure OpenAI for scalable production-ready AI solutions.
Strong backend development experience with Python, FastAPI, Docker, and frontend integration using React.js and Vue.js for AI-powered tools.
Demonstrated leadership through mentoring and managing teams of 5+, guiding full project lifecycles from ideation to production deployment.
Adept at automating repetitive workflows using AI, such as document redaction, abbreviation extraction, and multi-region CTD document generation, reducing manual effort by over 90%.
Proven ability to translate complex AI/ML concepts into business value, delivering solutions that improve operational efficiency, reduce risk, and accelerate decision-making in enterprise environments.

projects.name: AI-Powered CTD Module 2 (QOS) Generator
projects.description:
AI-Powered CTD Module 2 (QOS) Generator
Challenge: Manual authoring of the Quality Overall Summary (QOS) for regulatory submissions was time-consuming, error-prone, and dependent on specialized tribal knowledge.
Solution: Developed an end-to-end AI platform using a fine-tuned GPT-4o model with few-shot learning to generate section-wise draft summaries from source technical data and historical submissions. Managed via a human-in-the-loop dashboard for expert review and approval.
Impact: Reduced QOS authoring cycle from weeks/months to days, minimized regulatory risk, and freed SMEs to focus on high-value scientific review.
Tech: Azure OpenAI (GPT-4o), Few-Shot Learning, Vector Embeddings, Python, FastAPI, Docker, React.js, AWS (S3, ECS, Lambda), Microsoft Office Add-in.

projects.name: Hierarchical RAG Pipeline for Contextual Retrieval
projects.description:
Hierarchical RAG Pipeline for Contextual Retrieval
Challenge: Traditional RAG pipelines break document structure, leading to context-poor and inaccurate outputs.
Solution: Built a hierarchical RAG system parsing documents into logical trees. Child chunks are vectorized and indexed in OpenSearch, while full parent sections are retrieved to enrich LLM prompts.
Impact: Improved accuracy, relevance, and reliability of LLM responses by preserving full document context.
Tech: AWS S3 & OpenSearch, Azure Document Intelligence, GPT-4 & Claude 3, Python, Hierarchical Data Structures.

projects.name: Documender Multi-Agent Enhancement
projects.description:
Documender Multi-Agent Enhancement
Challenge: Original Documender tool produced inconsistent outputs requiring extensive manual reviews.
Solution: Refactored into reusable components and implemented a multi-agent system with LangGraph to automate critique-and-refinement loops against a scoring rubric.
Impact: Enabled automated multi-persona review, reduced review cycles, and ensured consistent high-quality output.
Tech: LangGraph, GPT-4o, Multi-Agent Systems, Python, FastAPI, Docker.

projects.name: CTD Colour Extractor Utility
projects.description:
CTD Colour Extractor Utility
Challenge: Manual creation of region-specific regulatory documents took ~150 hours per molecule and was error-prone.
Solution: Developed an automation tool with a single-source-of-truth approach. The system reads a color-coded master Word document and generates region-specific documents programmatically.
Impact: Reduced processing time by 99%, eliminated copy-paste errors, and simplified version control.
Tech: Python, GPT-4o, Vue.js, python-docx, Document Automation.
Nov 2021 - Dec 2022 | Amadeus, Bangalore | Software Engineer

projects.name: Redaction Bot
projects.description:
Redaction Bot
Challenge: Manual redaction of PII from large clinical and research documents (up to 3,000 pages) was time-consuming and required compliance with HIPAA, GDPR, and Health Canada regulations.
Solution: Developed an RPA-based Python application that automates PII detection using AWS Comprehend and Hugging Face NER models, applies masking via AWS Textract and PyMuPDF, and validates results using Azure OpenAI GPT-4.
Impact: Streamlined redaction process, reduced manual effort, and improved quality control, significantly accelerating document processing.
Tech: PyMuPDF, Fitz, AWS Textract & SageMaker, Hugging Face, LangChain, Azure OpenAI GPT-4, Chain-of-Thought Prompting.

projects.name: Automated Abbreviation Web Portal
projects.description:
Automated Abbreviation Web Portal
Challenge: Medical writers spent hours manually extracting abbreviations and definitions from clinical documents.
Solution: Built a web portal allowing users to upload documents and automatically generate abbreviation lists using a deep learning NER model trained on 100,000+ clinical documents.
Impact: Reduced manual effort, improved accuracy, and enhanced workflow efficiency for medical writers.
Tech: Hugging Face, AWS, Python, Pandas, Docx, Named Entity Recognition (NER).
Dec 2017 - Nov 2021 | ValueLabs, Bangalore | Software Engineer

projects.name: Text Classification API for Ehelpline
projects.description:
Text Classification API for Ehelpline
Challenge: Existing Elastic Search-based API for classifying internal helpline tickets at ValueLabs was inaccurate and required significant manual effort.
Solution: Developed a Machine Learning-based API using pre-trained word embeddings, improving classification accuracy up to 90%, and deployed it as a Flask API.
Impact: Increased accuracy of ticket classification, reduced manual effort, and improved routing for better customer experience.
Tech: Neural Networks, Keras, TensorFlow, Scikit-Learn, Pandas, Flask.

projects.name: Loan Closing Date Prediction (Gallagher Solutions)
projects.description:
Loan Closing Date Prediction (Gallagher Solutions)
Challenge: Gallagher Solutions needed to predict loan closing dates to manage resources efficiently and reduce risk.
Solution: Built a machine learning model trained on historical loan applications to predict closing dates.
Impact: Reduced mean absolute error (MAE) from 24 to 10, enabling more accurate decision-making, resource planning, and risk mitigation.
Tech: Machine Learning, Python, Scikit-Learn, Flask, Data Science.
